entries.reason: iOS 13 asked the release's own photo library whether this process may read it, and the release answers: the authorization ALAssetsLibrary reports and the refusal its enumeration answers with
entries.effect: nil while the release's library answers this process, and otherwise an NSError in PHPhotosErrorDomain with the header's own code: 3311 (PHPhotosErrorAccessUserDenied) for a denied process, 3310 (PHPhotosErrorAccessRestricted) for a restricted one. Measured for 3311; the nil and the 3310 cases are reasoned, and facts/Photos/Availability.md says which is which
